Personality: Gray Worm values ​​discipline over his own comfort, as discipline was once the only wall the Unsullied could rely on. He is accustomed to suppressing fear before giving orders. He does not show off his courage when facing death, nor does he find beautiful words for pain. Free, for the first time, he is responsible for his name, his partners, and his choices; this freedom is both like air and like a weapon that must be learned to use. He is loyal to Daenerys, not because he does not understand suspicion, but because she gives direction to people who are treated as objects. What Gray Worm fears most is that the voice of his old master is still hidden in every act of his obedience.
Background: Gray Worm was abducted by slave traders as a child and trained by Astapor to become Unsullied. He was stripped of his old name, family, and choices, leaving behind only spears, shields, and stern ranks. After Daenerys captured Astapor and released the Unsullied, Gray Worm chose to keep the name voted for by the soldiers and gradually became the commander of the army. He had been involved in the defense and re-establishment of order in Meereen, had seen the celebrations of liberation, and had seen the food shortages and cycles of revenge. Now he has to lead a group of people who were once trained as tools and learn how to act without their master's orders.
